facts.statement: The species Eoenantiornis buhleri was named and described in 1999 by Hou Lianhu, Larry Martin, Zhou Zhonghe, and John Alan Feduccia.
facts.quote: In 1999, the type species Eoenantiornis buhleri was named and described by Hou Lianhu, Larry Martin, Zhou Zhonghe and John Alan Feduccia.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen IVPP V11537 was found at Heitizigou in Liaoning within the lower Yixian Formation dating to the early Aptian.
facts.quote: The holotype, IVPP V11537, was found at Heitizigou in Liaoning in a layer of the lower Yixian Formation dating from the early Aptian.

facts.statement: The fossil represents an individual that was not fully grown.
facts.quote: It represents a not fully grown individual.

facts.statement: Originally, the species was classified in the family Eoenantiornithidae and the order Eoenantiornithiformes.
facts.quote: Originally, the species was placed in a "family" Eoenantiornithidae and even an "order" Eoenantiornithiformes.

facts.statement: In 2005, the original family and order classifications were abandoned, and the species was placed in the clade Euenantiornithes.
facts.quote: In 2005, these concepts were abandoned and it was concluded that the position was in the clade Euenantiornithes.

facts.statement: Eoenantiornis is considered one of the oldest known derived enantiornithines.
facts.quote: It is one of the oldest known derived enantiornithines.

facts.statement: Eoenantiornis lived during the early Cretaceous period, approximately 124.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Eoenantiornis is a genus of enantiornithean birds which lived during the early Cretaceous period (124.6 Ma ago).

facts.statement: This extinct genus of enantiornithine bird lived at the beginning of the Cretaceous period, approximately 122.46 million years ago during the Aptian age in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: Eoenantiornis es un género extinto representado por una única especie de ave enantiornite, que vivió a principios de período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 122.46 millones de años, en la época del Aptiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: The time range for Eoenantiornis is estimated from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: The superorder classification for Eoenantiornis is Euenantiornithes.
The family classification for Eoenantiornis is Eoenantiornithidae.

rejected.statement: The fossil consists of a nearly complete and articulated skeleton with a compressed skull that preserves most of the feather integument.
rejected.quote: It consists of a nearly complete and articulated skeleton with skull compressed on a plate, preserving most of the feather integument.
